available_datasets.name: LEVIR-CD (256px cropped)
available_datasets.description: Satellite building-change detection dataset, pre-cropped to 256x256 tiles with official train/validation/test splits and binary change masks. Automatically downloaded, split, and organized into the required folder structure with no manual steps.
available_datasets.approx_size: A subset of ~2,800 image pairs by default (2000 train / 400 validation / 400 test), roughly 300-800 MB depending on network conditions
available_datasets.license: See dataset page for license and citation terms (derived from LEVIR-CD, Chen & Shi, 2020)
available_datasets.type: Paired Satellite Images + Building Change Masks

available_datasets.name: LEVIR-CD+ (full resolution, larger download)
available_datasets.description: Higher-resolution (1024x1024) version of LEVIR-CD with only train/test splits. Larger and slower to download; use only if you want higher-resolution training data and have a fast connection.
available_datasets.approx_size: ~3.8 GB downloaded, auto-resized to 512px tiles on save
available_datasets.license: See dataset page for license and citation terms (Chen & Shi, 2020)
available_datasets.type: Paired Satellite Images + Building Change Masks
